full_details: Frost on a strange town. The company had gone to the parish church in a body, in clean bands, and been stared at as players. The court kept its own chapel two hundred yards off, and you were not in it. Dinner was the stock's, at the inn's long table. Brawn and mustard, a goose, and a minced pie as broad as a drum-head. Pope carved. Phillips gave Nick the lowest and the fewest notes, three of them, and stopped him. The note held. Kemp drank the health of the grocer who will be first on the Queen's next paper and wait until his beard is grey. Bryan forbade the ale after six, and the table stopped. You sat a while with another table in your mind, nine at it, your own stool carried back to the shop, and a grey kerchief that should be there by now. You do not know that it is. Sam asked whether a court laughs differently from a yard. The grown men gave him four answers. You told him the only one worth having is tomorrow, at about ten. Then he asked how a fairy runs, and you got up and showed him with your feet, and no speech. After, three cloaks dried before a small fire in the shared chamber.
one_sentence: You kept Christmas at a strange table, heard a carol cut to three notes, and got up to show a boy how a fairy runs.
title: Three notes of a carol, and a fairy's feet
